project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which this spec must be instantiated.

assetToModelRelationFilter.description:
The post training job is run for the {@link ReliabilityAsset} and {@link ReliabilityMlModel} pairs in the
{@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} specified by the {@link #assetToModelRelationFilter}, if
the model is deployed on the asset as a `CANDIDATE`.

referenceTimeRange.description:
The reference period for which a {@link ReliabilityMl.ModelOutput}s are generated in order to determine how the
model performs. This usually can correspond to the training period for the model, since the model is expected to
perform well on the training data

Use `ReliabilityMl.TimeRange.TRAIN` to use the training time range associated with a {@link ReliabilityMlModel#datasetPreparationRun},
or instead provide your own custom time range.

The model outputs from this period can be compared with the model outputs generated for the {@link #comparisonTimeRange} to
classify the model.

comparisonTimeRange.description:
The comparison period for which a {@link ReliabilityMl.ModelOutput}s are generated in order to determine how the
model performs. This can correspond to the validation period for the model, since the model is expected to
perform well as well on held out validation data as the training data.

Use `ReliabilityMl.TimeRange.VAL` to use the validation time range associated with a {@link ReliabilityMlModel#datasetPreparationRun},
or instead provide your own custom time range.

The model outputs from this period can be compared with the model outputs generated for the {@link #referenceTimeRange} to
classify the model.

doNotClassify.description:
Specify whether to classify the model after it is trained. By default this
field is set to False, meaning the model will be classified.
The classification logic must be specified in the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#classifyModelForAssetLambda} associated with the
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJob}

doNotValidate.description:
Specify whether to validate the model after it is trained. By default this
field is set to False, meaning the model will be validated.

doNotGenerateValidationReports.description:
Specify whether to generate model validation reports for the model after it is trained.
By default this field is set to False, meaning that a model report will be generated.
The reporting logic must be specified in the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#reportModelForAssetLambda} associated with the
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJob}
